body:
January and February have been amazingly full … with a steady stream of guests at home and a full plate of travel too. I’ve been in Illinois, Georgia (twice), South Carolina, Kansas, DC, California, Minnesota, and Virginia so far in 2012. In March I’ll be in Virginia, Kansas, and Alabama, and when at home, I’ll doing final edits on my upcoming (September 11 release) book. Here’s a draft of the UK edition’s cover … (US cover in process):

I have one other big project to announce but that will have to wait for a few more days. Stay tuned!

Thanks to all the amazing people I’ve met already this year. If you saw what I’ve seen, heard what I’ve heard, and met whom I’ve met, you’d be as hopeful as I am.
